Line 404: keep translucency subtle and warm; if the fabric is glowing too evenly, reduce translucency intensity or slightly warm only the backscatter so the cloth stays readable in daylight.

Lines 407-412: refine the cloth microdetail shader so it reads as woven cotton rather than generic procedural noise; try weave_noise Scale around 120-160, Detail 5-6, and soft_noise Scale around 14-18 with Detail reduced to 4-5.
Lines 370-371: if these wave settings influence surface breakup, make them less broad and synthetic; test Scale around 24-32 and Distortion around 0.8-1.1 for more natural textile variation.

Line 524: if this noise affects wood/post weathering, increase variation to add age and grain detail; a higher scale range around 10-18 may help break up the overly clean surfaces.

Outside the listed material params, increase wind strength/gust amplitude, add more turbulence, and reduce cloth damping so the pose shows sharper flutter, stronger tension radiating from the pinned points, and more violent flapping.
